task.topic: How accurately do Patoc-antigen lateral-flow IgM assays identify acute human leptospirosis relative to each source-defined reference standard?

pico.population: Patients with suspected acute human leptospirosis
pico.comparator: Source-defined reference standard (MAT, IgM ELISA, culture, or their prespecified combination)

candidate_capture_policy.record_scope: One complete source-supported Patoc-antigen LFA 2x2 table per index-test/reference-standard timepoint.

targets.quantitative_use_policy: Extract source-supported TP, FP, FN, and TN for a Patoc-antigen LFA and the study-defined reference standard. Recompute sensitivity and specificity from counts. Do not derive counts from percentages or use a review forest value.

extraction.model_selection_policy: Preserve every source-reported candidate; no study or effect selection occurs in extraction.
extraction.evidence_requirements: Transcribe only source-supported data, preserve exact evidence, and do not calculate, pool, choose an analysis record, or infer missing values.
